meta._yoast_wpseo_title: ScalaHosting Review 2026: Prices, Speed, Black Friday
meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: ScalaHosting review for 2026: plan prices, Black Friday cloud deal, speed tests from HostingAdvice, AI features, pros and cons, from the host and named testers.
meta.rl_answer: ScalaHosting is a solid managed cloud host. HostingAdvice scored its WordPress cloud plan an A. Renewal prices rise sharply, and the Black Friday deal is on cloud plans only.
meta.rl_faqs:
Is ScalaHosting good? | It is a solid managed cloud host. HostingAdvice scored its WordPress cloud plan an A on GTmetrix. Renewal prices rise sharply, and it has limited AI features.
Is ScalaHosting good for WordPress? | HostingAdvice tested a cloud WordPress plan and reported an A on GTmetrix with a largest contentful paint of 983 ms.
How much does ScalaHosting cost? | Shared plans start at $2.95 a month on a 1-year term, according to TechRadar. Entry Cloud is $11.21 a month on a 1-year term during the Black Friday offer, against a $39.95 standard price.
Does ScalaHosting have a Black Friday deal? | Yes, on cloud plans only, from 19 October to 1 December 2026. There is no shared hosting deal this year.
What is SPanel? | SPanel is ScalaHosting's own control panel for managing sites, email and backups.
Does ScalaHosting have AI features? | It lists SShield, which it describes as AI-powered security. We did not find an AI builder or assistant on the pages we read.
